summary: Vovchok Academy Mini App — new onboarding funnel (channel-subscription gate) + header centering fully verified at https://vovchok-mini.preview.emergentagent.com/api/miniapp/ in mobile viewport 390x844. HEADER CENTERING: On onboarding sheet and on home (visible) sheet, .toprow .brand is horizontally centered within .sheet (|brandCenter - sheetCenter| ≈ 0px, well within 6px tolerance) for ru/uk/ar; .beta is flush to the right edge in LTR (right gap ≈ 15px) and to the LEFT edge in RTL/ar (left gap ≈ 15px). ONBOARDING #s0: 4 stepdots rendered, three onboarding-lang-{ru|uk|ar} buttons switch language instantly (bubble text updates: ru 'Привет! Ты попал в', uk 'Привіт! Ти потрапив', ar 'مرحباً! أنت في أكا', dir=rtl only for ar), onboarding-start-button uses cyan→blue→indigo gradient (linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(121,240,255), rgb(46,168,255), rgb(109,123,255))) and navigates to #s1. ONBOARDING #s1: onboarding-conditions has class 'hide' initially (offsetParent=null); after ~2.4s class removed and conditions appear, bubble text swaps to 'Условие одно — подписка на главный' (uk 'Умова одна — підписка', ar 'شرط واحد — الاشترا'); onboarding-subscribe-button href=https://t.me/+LbZDg2Te0XE0OGJh with target=_blank; onboarding-verify-button href=#s2; clicking subscribe intercepts popup to the t.me URL and adds class 'on' to #condTick. ONBOARDING #s2: onboarding-check-percent counts 14→28→42→58→72→88→100% (~55ms interval, ~3s total), onboarding-check-1..4 li get class 'on' progressively (~25% thresholds), localStorage va_uid='tg' is set, then auto-navigates to #s3 ~0.7s after 100%. ONBOARDING #s3: onboarding-reward visible, onboarding-showcase has 4 .tile each with canvas.scene width=112px, #confetti has exactly 28 <i> nodes, onboarding-enter-button uses green gradient (linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(125,255,195), rgb(34,197,94))) with href=#home; clicking it removes #story and lands on home with home-to-learn-button + bottom-nav (5 tabs: nav-home/nav-learn/nav-practice/nav-community/nav-profile). RELOAD without ?reset=1 (va_uid persisted) goes straight to home (hash empty, no #story). Full funnel executed successfully in ru, uk (LTR), and ar (RTL) — all localized strings correct, VA_MISSING === [] after every step. REGRESSION: bottom nav renders 5 tabs, profile counters render (50/1 lessons, 13/1 practice after test completion), no console errors, zero pageerror events. Only warnings observed are benign Telegram.WebApp v6.0 compatibility notes (unrelated). BOT SANITY: cd /app/miniapp && BOT_TOKEN=x python -c 'import bot; ...' — bot.tx('ru','hello') text contains 'Условие входа одно — подписка на главный канал академии'; bot.app_kb('ru').inline_keyboard[0][0].text == 'Подписаться на канал'. node tools/check-i18n.js exits 0 ('lessons=50 pages=74 practices=13 langs=ru,uk,ar / i18n OK'). No deprecated Expo packages (vanilla JS mini app). No red screens. All specified acceptance criteria met.
critical_code_review_comments: story.js correctly gates the funnel: if va_uid is set, no reset flag, and hash is not #s*, it returns early — reload behavior verified.

motion.css .toprow uses position:relative + justify-content:center with .beta absolutely positioned, and RTL flips right→left. This is the correct fix for the previously off-center header — confirmed pixel-accurate on both onboarding and home sheets.
step 2 setInterval id is stored in timers[] and cleared on stepFromHash change, avoiding leaks when user navigates back before 100%.
step 3 uses VAChart.mount per tile with unique seeds and renders 28 confetti pieces — matches spec exactly.
seed_data_creation: Fresh funnel triggered via ?reset=1 for ru/uk/ar. After completion, localStorage va_uid='tg' and va_lang set; reload without reset skips funnel as intended.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding steps use hash #s0..#s3 injected by /app/miniapp/story.js. Testids: onboarding, onboarding-lang-{ru|uk|ar}, onboarding-start-button, onboarding-steps, onboarding-bubble, onboarding-conditions, onboarding-subscribe-button, onboarding-verify-button, onboarding-check, onboarding-check-percent, onboarding-check-1..4, onboarding-checklist, onboarding-reward, onboarding-showcase, onboarding-enter-button. To test funnel: navigate to `.../api/miniapp/?reset=1` then wait ~2.7s on #s1 for conditions reveal. Step2 auto-advances to #s3 after 100% + 0.7s. To bypass funnel: set localStorage.va_uid='demo'. Header centering uses motion.css rules .toprow{position:relative;justify-content:center} and .toprow .beta{position:absolute;right:0} (left:0 in [dir=rtl]). Bot sanity: cd /app/miniapp && BOT_TOKEN=x python -c 'import bot; ...'. i18n lint: node /app/miniapp/tools/check-i18n.js.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. Both requested fixes (header centering, redesigned subscribe-gate funnel with animated verification and reward) are implemented correctly and verified end-to-end in all three languages.
